'''Karl Hartford''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA beats]], according to Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1120">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00d1120/ milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-milwaukee-wisconsin-8-12-00d1120/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
